main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (about 30 px wide, rows 3-35) on a thin brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Organic canopy: lighter greens at the upper-right and centre-right of the crown (rows ~4-20) fade into darker greens lower down. There is no separate flat top band, but the volume reads as a rounded mass lit from above.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The canopy is a rounded volume with light on the upper part and darker, shadowed greens in the lower third, which gives a dark underside above the trunk. The trunk and the ground patch sit below it, so the tree reads as standing on the ground and viewed slightly from above. It has no flat horizontal slab and no receding side face. For an organic kind this is an acceptable 3/4 reading.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps, from a pale yellow-green highlight down to a deep green, and the clumps are dithered, so there is real variation with no large flat fills. The outline is a dark green rather than black. However, the references have distinct leaf clumps with individual highlights, a branch structure visible inside the crown, and a rooted, flared trunk. The candidate is a smoother, blobbier mass: the leaf clusters are less defined, the trunk is a thin 3-4 px stick with a flat-looking base, and the grass patch is simple. Overall it is a bit thinner and less crafted than the references, though not drastically so.
